title: Body-insurance claim review answers
description: Input contract for `claim.py review`. One entry per questionnaire item, plus the evidence the file actually holds. This is not a claim case: it cannot carry a rate, an order, or any other calculation parameter directly - answers bind slots in knowledge/parameter_slots.json, and the derived case is what the engine reads.

claim_id.description: File reference. No personal data: the repository holds synthetic and anonymised files only.

id.description: Accepted synonym for claim_id, matching the case schema.

unit.description: Applies to every money answer in this file. Money answers are never mixed within one file.

note.description: Why the file exists or what it demonstrates. Never read by the engine.

answers.description: Questionnaire answers keyed by ReviewQuestion node_id. Keys outside the procedure are refused, not ignored; inadmissible choice values are refused. 'UNKNOWN' is admissible and binds nothing - absence is recorded, never defaulted.

evidence_present.description: EvidenceItem ids confirmed to be in the file. Absence of an id here is what drives the 'EVIDENCE STILL MISSING' list; nothing infers a document from an answer.

evidence_received.description: Synonym channel for a form that only ticks documents off.

reviewed_by.description: Named reviewer, when the file records one separately from Q-S10-01.

as_of.description: Review date, for deterministic output in tests and audits.

x-answer-formats.list: array of tokens, or array of objects for component records
x-answer-formats.money: number or numeric string, in the file's declared unit
x-answer-formats.date: ISO-like string; a leading year between 1300 and 1500 is read as a Shamsi year
x-answer-formats.text: free text, used for identification and sign-off only; it may not bind a money slot

x-refusals: choice value outside the closed vocabulary
non-numeric money answer or non-integer integer answer
a payload that is not a JSON object
